name: mta
what_it_holds: Data visualization app for NYC MTA turnstile data (9 stars, updated Dec 2025).
why_useful: Marginal; another visualization layer over the same MTA source.
themes: Public transit ridership and airport rail links (MTA, TfL, RATP, JR) as visitor proxies; ridership open data
why_all: Marginal; another visualization layer over the same MTA source.

name: tfl-bikes-data-pipeline
what_it_holds: GCP-based pipeline (45 stars, GPL-3.0, updated May 2026) processing TfL Santander Cycles (bike-share) usage data; not rail/tube ridership.
why_useful: Bike-share usage as a secondary London mobility/tourism proxy; lower relevance than direct tube/rail ridership but still a maintained TfL Open Data pull.
themes: Public transit ridership and airport rail links (MTA, TfL, RATP, JR) as visitor proxies; ridership open data
why_all: Bike-share usage as a secondary London mobility/tourism proxy; lower relevance than direct tube/rail ridership but still a maintained TfL Open Data pull.

name: bmrcl-ridership-hourly
what_it_holds: 55-star, ODbL-licensed dataset of hourly, station-wise ridership on Bengaluru's Namma Metro (BMRCL), sourced from RTI (India's Right-to-Information filings); actively updated (Jul 2026).
why_useful: Not a current ABNB market but demonstrates a reusable RTI-sourced-ridership pattern for APAC metros; low direct relevance, flagged for completeness/method transfer to other APAC cities (gap #7).
themes: Public transit ridership and airport rail links (MTA, TfL, RATP, JR) as visitor proxies; ridership open data
why_all: Not a current ABNB market but demonstrates a reusable RTI-sourced-ridership pattern for APAC metros; low direct relevance, flagged for completeness/method transfer to other APAC cities (gap #7).

name: blr-metro-ridership
what_it_holds: 21-star analysis/dataset ('How Bangalore Uses the Metro') built on the same Namma Metro ridership data, MIT licensed, actively updated (Aug 2026).
why_useful: Companion/derivative of bmrcl-ridership-hourly; same low direct ABNB relevance, cataloged for completeness.
themes: Public transit ridership and airport rail links (MTA, TfL, RATP, JR) as visitor proxies; ridership open data
why_all: Companion/derivative of bmrcl-ridership-hourly; same low direct ABNB relevance, cataloged for completeness.

name: namma-metro-ridership-tracker
what_it_holds: 21-star tracker of Bengaluru Namma Metro ridership over time, actively updated (Sep 2026).
why_useful: Third repo on the same Bengaluru metro ridership theme; low ABNB relevance, cataloged for completeness only.
themes: Public transit ridership and airport rail links (MTA, TfL, RATP, JR) as visitor proxies; ridership open data
why_all: Third repo on the same Bengaluru metro ridership theme; low ABNB relevance, cataloged for completeness only.
